basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream Victorian-style two-level condo in the heart of Lower Pacific Heights, San Francisco! This stunning residence features a recently remodeled kitchen and two updated bathrooms, making it move-in ready for modern living. Enjoy exclusive use of a charming outdoor patio and a private deck, perfect for al fresco dining or relaxing in the sun. With a generous layout, this home offers ample space for both entertaining and everyday living. Additional features include extra storage for all your needs and one designated parking spot for ultimate convenience. Boasting a remarkable 94 walkability score, you'll be just steps away from shops, dining, and parks, allowing you to fully embrace the vibrant lifestyle this neighborhood has to offer. Don't miss the opportunity to make this beautiful condo your new home!
